html:
G'oya

Maktab bo'yicha guruhlaymiz. Maxraj testga kelganlar: COUNT(score) NULL larni sanamaydi. Surat muvaffaqiyatlilar soni, uni SUM(CASE ...) beradi, va CASE ichida chegara yo'nalishga qarab tanlanadi. Hech kim kelmagan maktabda maxraj 0, uni NULLIF ushlaydi.

Yechim

SELECT school,
       COUNT(score) AS took,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE
                           WHEN track = 'grant' AND score >= 150 THEN 1
                           WHEN track = 'kontrakt' AND score >= 110 THEN 1
                           ELSE 0
                         END)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(score), 0), 1) AS success_pct
FROM applicants
GROUP BY school

12-maktabda 5 bitiruvchidan 4 tasi kelgan. 148.9 ball grantga yetmaydi, 115 kontraktga yetadi: 4 tadan 2 tasi, 50.0. Kelmagan bitiruvchining bali NULL, score >= 110 rost emas va CASE uni ELSE 0 ga yuboradi.

Tuzoqlar

Hammaga bitta chegara qo'yish. 12-maktabdagi grantchi 148.9 ball bilan kontraktga kirardi, lekin u grantga topshirgan va muvaffaqiyatsiz:

Noto'g'riSELECT school,
       COUNT(score) AS took,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 110 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(score), 0), 1) AS success_pct
FROM applicants
GROUP BY school

COUNT(*) ga bo'lish kelmaganlarni ham maxrajga qo'shadi va 12-maktab 40.0 oladi. Prezident maktabidagi 150.0 va 31-maktabdagi 110.0 chegaraning o'zi, ular muvaffaqiyatli: >=, > emas.

Boshqa yo'l

Chegarani ichki CASE bilan tanlab, muvaffaqiyatlilarni COUNT bilan sanash mumkin:

SELECT school,
       COUNT(score) AS took,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN score >= CASE track WHEN 'grant' THEN 150 ELSE 110 END
                                THEN 1 END)
             / NULLIF(COUNT(score), 0), 1) AS success_pct
FROM applicants
GROUP BY school

Dialektlar farqi

NULLIF siz PostgreSQL 5-maktabda "division by zero" xatosini beradi, SQLite esa NULL qaytaradi.
